note: dual mode (experimental): reward = (offline reward + online reward) / 2, each the item's unrounded reward (robotics_grader.ratio_rewards against its own anchor: tests/anchor_offline.json, main's anchor.json byte-identical, and tests/anchor_online.json; both assembly_score with value 1.0 and full_at 1.0); the mean is written through ratio_rewards once more against this anchor with cap 1.0 and full_at 1.0, so the reward is the mean itself. The offline item grades the program frozen at the earlier of the graded start and the start window's close (or at the session's end when the session ends before the window closes without a start) exactly as main does; the online item scores the graded episode's record (tests/online_record.py).
